WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds" AS cds,
        s."sname" AS sname,
        s."numge1500"::numeric / NULLIF(s."numtsttakr", 0) AS excellence_rate
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."numtsttakr" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."numtsttakr" <> 0
      AND s."numge1500" IS NOT NULL
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT
        r."sname" AS sname,
        MAX(r.excellence_rate) AS excellence_rate
    FROM ranked r
    GROUP BY r."sname"
    ORDER BY excellence_rate DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
    sc."phone" AS phone
FROM "schools" sc
JOIN "satscores" s ON s."cds" = sc."cdscode"
JOIN top3 t ON t."sname" = s."sname"
GROUP BY sc."phone", t."excellence_rate"
ORDER BY t."excellence_rate" DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname1") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname2") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname3") <> ''
),

name_counts AS (
    SELECT "first_name", COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)

SELECT nc."first_name", nc.cnt AS frequency, an."district"
FROM name_counts nc
JOIN admin_names an ON an."first_name" = nc."first_name"
GROUP BY nc."first_name", nc.cnt, an."district"
ORDER BY nc.cnt DESC NULLS LAST, nc."first_name", an."district";

SELECT

    AVG(ss."avgscrwrite") AS avg_writing_score,
    s."phone" AS phone_number
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "satscores" ss
    ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE
    
    (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate" <> '' AND s."opendate" > DATE '1991-12-31')
    OR
    
    (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate" <> '' AND s."closeddate" < DATE '2000-01-01')

    s."school",
    s."phone"
ORDER BY
    avg_writing_score DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
      AND s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."closeddate" <> ''
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
    ORDER BY closed_count DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN county_counts cc
  ON cs."county" = cc."county"
ORDER BY cs."school";

36:
WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT ss."cds", ss."numge1500"
    FROM "satscores" ss
    ORDER BY ss."numge1500" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    s."school",
    t."numge1500",
    adm."full_name"
FROM top_school t
JOIN "schools" s
    ON s."cdscode" = t."cds"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
        (s."admfname1", s."admlname1"),
        (s."admfname2", s."admlname2"),
        (s."admfname3", s."admlname3")
) AS adm(first_name, last_name)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', adm.first_name, adm.last_name)) AS "full_name"
) AS adm_full
WHERE adm.first_name IS NOT NULL
  AND adm.last_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', adm.first_name, adm.last_name)) <> ''
ORDER BY adm."full_name";
